text:
Amy: heads-up — we're still not reliably linking logs -> traces for private deployments. lots of log lines have request_id but no trace_id, so Console can't jump from a log line to a span.

Omar: agree. two approaches: inject trace_id into structured logs at runtime (middleware) OR enrich logs in the collector by joining span context. both have tradeoffs.

Sasha: collector enrichment is attractive for non-instrumented apps, but it only works if the collector receives both logs and spans with matching context (or if we can co-locate sidecars). legacy apps that write plaintext to filebeat are tricky. for greenfield services, we should add structured logger hooks that pull trace id from current span.

Ben: for Node we can wrap Pino/PW logger and add: 
```js
const span = tracer.getCurrentSpan();
const traceId = span?.spanContext?.()?.traceId;
logger = logger.child({ trace_id: traceId });
```
async context propagation makes this fiddly across timers/promises though.

Amy: we need a standard field name for Console and dashboards. my vote: top-level trace_id as 32-char lowercase hex (W3C) with no prefix. searchable and simple. anyone opposed?

Omar: +1 on top-level `trace_id` (no nesting). also prefer no 0x prefix. Console filters are easier with a single flat key.

Sasha: implementation idea for collector: in otel-collector pipeline, add an attributes processor that copies span.trace_id into the LogRecord when present. pipeline: receivers (filelog/otlp) -> processors (resourcedetection, attributes(copy trace->log), batch, sampling) -> exporters. fallback: if only request_id present, we could maintain a small in-memory map to link request_id->trace_id during process lifetime, but that's stateful and risky.

Ben: cost-wise, enriching every log line for 90-day retention will explode storage. can we only enrich logs above error or when duration > threshold? or add an `is_linkable` boolean field and only index linkable logs?

Amy: good call. propose retention rules: structured full logs 30d, error/exception logs 90d; trace and metric indices 90d. for linking, enrich and index `trace_id` for error logs and sampled slow traces.

Omar: proposed rollout plan: 1) update SDKs (Node/Python/Go) to inject `trace_id` for new services; 2) add collector attributes processor to copy trace ctx into logs for OTLP flows; 3) add a sampled log-enrichment path for filelog flows where feasible; 4) update Console search/UI to detect `trace_id` and show "Open in Traces" link. incrementally migrate legacy services.

Sasha: edge cases: logs emitted before span creation (startup) will have null trace_id — Console should hide link gracefully. also watch for batched spans where trace_id might not be present in logs until later.

Ben: watch opentelemetry SDK versions — older JS/Python libs had propagation bugs. add a compat checklist in RFC.

Amy: I'll draft a short RFC with sample pino/structlog patches + an otel-collector attributes processor snippet. want someone to own the collector snippet?

Omar: I'll take the collector snippet. /assign @Omar :hammer_and_wrench: 

deploy-bot: created RFC draft: https://redwood-internal.docs/rfcs/2026/telemetry/log-trace-correlation — please review and comment. :eyes:

Amy: thanks — ping me when you have the collector snippet and I'll wire it into the RFC. :thumbsup:
